architecture: Tauri 2 Windows app, React/Vite UI, native Rust pdf-core library. All documents stay local. Keep original inputs untouched. Origami visual language: paper #FAFAF7, ink #1C1F1E, green #0F5C4A, Manrope.

commands.run_operation: {request:OperationRequest} -> OperationResult; emits job-progress {id,completed,total,message}; one active job at a time

types.DocumentInfo: {id:string,path:string,name:string,pages:number,size:number,revision:string,pageSizes?:[number,number][]}; revision is the content fingerprint; every explicit reopen invalidates rendered/text/search caches, while annotations survive only an unchanged revision
types.OperationRequest: {id:string,kind:string,inputs:string[],output:string,pages?:string,password?:string,inputPasswords?:Record<string,string>,newPassword?:string,text?:string,rotation?:number,dpi?:number,imagePaths?:string[],rects?:RedactRect[],annotation?:Annotation,annotations?:Annotation[],ocr?:boolean,downloadUrl?:string,sha256?:string,targetDir?:string}; credentials are bound to exact input paths, never inherited from an unrelated active tab; an explicit source password takes precedence over cached credentials for single-input operations; merge resolves each input separately; engine applies all annotations when batch present; pdf-to-word detects scanned pages per page and uses local OCR automatically (ocr:false opts out); install-ocr accepts only the pinned archive URL/hash and default per-user installation directory
types.OutputFreshness: Engine refuses existing output files and non-empty output directories before work; stages complete results on the destination volume, publishes without replacement even when a destination appears during processing, preserves destination NTFS access controls, and does not publish partial results on cancellation

invariants: Pages are 1-based. Page ranges accept 1,3-5 and reverse 5-1 for reorder.
No overwriting original inputs; output collisions explicitly refused by engine.
Output is file for most ops, directory for split/pdf-to-images/ocr.
Tauri native dialog plugin for open/save. Native drag-drop and CLI file association handled.
No fake browser-mode backend. UI reports native bridge unavailable in browser.
No builds/tests/formatters by subagents mid-flight; parent integration verifies afterward.
